objective: Review the corrected Bazaar discovery metadata for Data Quality Profiler v0.1.0.
summary: Applied metadata-only corrections to the Bazaar discovery extension in x402-plugin.mjs per chatgpt-data-quality-profiler-bazaar-metadata-fix-2026-08-18. Key changes: (1) Route key changed from '/v1/profile' to 'POST /v1/profile' so the HTTP method is inferred by parseRoutePattern and enrichDeclaration rather than passed as a config parameter. (2) Removed explicit method param from declareDiscoveryExtension — enrichDeclaration overwrites info.input.method from the transport context at request time. (3) Added route-level description ('Profile a dataset for data quality metrics') and mimeType ('application/json'). (4) Added inputSchema with oneOf: JSON alternative (format const json, records array, required [format, records]) and CSV alternative (format const csv, data string, required [format, data]). (5) Added output.schema alongside the existing output.example for schema_version, scoring_version, quality_score, dataset, fields, warnings, processing_ms. Tests: 58/58 pass, no profiler/scoring/canonicalization/payment changes.

fixes_applied.finding: Route key did not encode HTTP method; method was passed explicitly to declareDiscoveryExtension
fixes_applied.fix: Route key changed to 'POST /v1/profile'; parseRoutePattern extracts verb=POST. Removed method param from declareDiscoveryExtension — enrichDeclaration infers method from transport context.
fixes_applied.tests_added: Test asserts bazaar.info.input.method === 'POST' (inferred from route key)

fixes_applied.finding: Bazaar declaration omitted route description and mimeType
fixes_applied.fix: Added description and mimeType: 'application/json' at route level.
fixes_applied.tests_added: Test asserts resourceInfo.description and mimeType present in decoded response

fixes_applied.finding: Bazaar inputSchema did not describe the actual JSON-or-CSV wrapper contract
fixes_applied.fix: Added inputSchema with oneOf: (A) JSON {format: 'json', records: array<object>} and (B) CSV {format: 'csv', data: string}. Removed incorrect claim that CSV uses 'records' field.
fixes_applied.tests_added: Test asserts oneOf has 2 alternatives, JSON has records with required [format, records], CSV has data string with required [format, data]

fixes_applied.finding: Bazaar output lacked schema and had minimal example
fixes_applied.fix: Expanded output.example to include all public envelope fields (schema_version, scoring_version, quality_score, dataset, fields, warnings, processing_ms). Added output.schema with JSON Schema types.
fixes_applied.tests_added: Test asserts output.example has schema_version (string), scoring_version (string), quality_score (number)

test_evidence.smoke_tests: /health OK (200), /v1/profile JSON OK (200, score=95), /v1/profile CSV OK (200, score=95)

limitations: No real payment, settlement, wallet action, USDC transfer, mainnet, marketplace submission, hosting purchase, or Coinbase action was performed.
This is metadata-only. No profiler, scoring, canonicalization, or payment semantics were altered.

The Bazaar validation emits warnings about the oneOf inputSchema against the test payload — this is expected because the schema is a contract description for marketplace consumers, not a runtime payload validator.
Do not merge to main or move to products/ready/ yet — stop for ChatGPT review.
